name: The Tome of Divinity

angles.text: As a paladin, you face a milestone in your training at Stormwind. The trial tests whether you have the spiritual strength to wield the Symbol of Life.
As an Alliance member, you know Defias attacks near Heroes' Vigil threaten travelers and citizens across Elwynn Forest. The church must intervene.

faq.answer: Gazin Tenorm is an associate of Duthorian Rall. He barely escaped a Defias ambush near Heroes' Vigil in Elwynn Forest and was brought to Stormwind's Cathedral of Light with severe wounds. Local priests are treating him.

aliases: what does symbol of life do
faq.answer: The Symbol of Life is a holy relic entrusted to patient and charitable paladin initiates. It tests whether a rising champion has the spiritual focus and fortitude to channel one of the Holy Light's greatest gifts: the restoration of life.
faq.q: What is the Symbol of Life?

faq.answer: At Heroes' Vigil in Elwynn Forest, Defias outlaws ambushed Gazin Tenorm and his companion Henze. Gazin fled to Stormwind with grievous wounds, while Henze remains in danger.
Henze is Gazin Tenorm's companion. Defias bandits attacked them near Heroes' Vigil in Elwynn Forest, and Henze was left behind while Gazin reached Stormwind alive.

Duthorian Rall sends you to speak with Gazin Tenorm. A leader among Stormwind's Cathedral of Light paladins, he first confirms that an initiate has shown patience and charity, then directs them to Gazin at the altar.
faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Gazin Tenorm?

aliases: why are defias near heroes vigil
faq.answer: Defias outlaws and highwaymen ambush travelers across Elwynn Forest, even within striking distance of the capital. Gazin Tenorm's attack shows how brazen and deadly their operations have become.
faq.q: Why are Defias bandits attacking travelers near Heroes' Vigil?

sections.body: In Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, patient and charitable paladin initiates receive the Symbol of Life. Duthorian Rall entrusts them with this holy vessel to test their devotion to the Light. Only a worthy champion can focus one of the Light's greatest gifts, the power to restore life to the fallen.
sections.title: A Test of Devotion

sections.body: Gazin Tenorm shows why the Symbol is needed. He crawled back to Stormwind after Defias bandits attacked him near Heroes' Vigil in Elwynn Forest. Priests tend his severe wounds at the cathedral altar. His companion Henze remains in danger where the outlaws struck.
sections.title: Ambush at Heroes' Vigil

summary: At Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, a trial awaits paladin initiates: they must focus the holy Symbol of Life. Those who prove their virtue are sent to aid Gazin Tenorm, who barely escaped a Defias ambush near Heroes' Vigil in Elwynn Forest.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Tome of Divinity
